Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 93 (NTT VA campus missing-address campaign): applied 44710 Gigabit Plaza, Ashburn, VA 20147, from a reverse geocode corroborated by a match to the distinctive Gigabit Plaza street name already tier-1 confirmed for sibling rows VA3 and VA7. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete.

[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed in the registry to NTT, part of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications and IT services groups in the world, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. NTT operates a global data center business, NTT Global Data Centers, under NTT DATA, Inc. The operators own about us page, fetched this session, states NTT DATA is a top 10 global IT services provider with about 30 billion dollars in annual revenue, operations across 33 countries, and about 3 billion dollars in annual research and development investment, headquartered at the Toyosu Center Building, 3-3-3 Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo 135-6033, Japan, though these figures describe the wider NTT DATA organization rather than the data center division specifically, and no data center division formation or acquisition date was found on the pages fetched this session. A previously confirmed, specific data center acquisition remains NTT Communications purchase of an 86.7 percent stake in e-shelter, described as Germany top data center operator, completed around June 23, 2015, though that acquisition is not directly connected to this United States facility. This session reached the operators own services.global.ntt data center locations pages directly and successfully. An earlier sessions attempts to reach the ragingwire.com domain had failed and found no corresponding Wikipedia article, a negative finding this session did not need to repeat. No dedicated VA9 facility page was found this session (404). Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 44710 Gigabit Plz, Ashburn, VA 20147 at 0.9 confidence, which this session writes out in full as Gigabit Plaza to match the spelling already confirmed from the operators own dedicated pages for sibling rows VA3, at 44245 Gigabit Plaza, and VA7, at 44371 Gigabit Plaza. Given this rows geocode lands on the same distinctively named street as two siblings whose own addresses are independently confirmed from the operators own dedicated pages, this session treats that match as the corroborating check in place of a named source, which this session did not find for VA9 specifically, and applies the address, flagged for a future researcher to confirm against a named source if the operator later publishes a dedicated VA9 page.

reading.body:
NTT Ashburn VA9 is one of 326 mapped data center facilities in Virginia, but its power capacity is not published. Of the 23 Virginia facilities with published specifications, this campus ranks 24th, placing it outside the published tier. Without a disclosed megawatt figure, its contribution to Virginia's 1375.4 MW of published data center capacity cannot be quantified.

The facility sits on Gigabit Plaza in Ashburn, the core of Northern Virginia's data center cluster. Ashburn hosts the densest concentration of large data centers in the United States, drawn by proximity to internet exchanges, fiber routes, and the aging but still-functional regional grid. A campus at this address with no published power spec is either smaller than the threshold operators typically disclose, or operates under a confidentiality restriction common in the region.

Without power capacity, racks, or tenant information in the published record, this facility's relevance to AI scaling cannot be read from available data. NTT operates a global data center portfolio and has made acquisitions in Europe, but no specific investments in US AI infrastructure are stated here. Researchers tracking AI infrastructure growth should flag this site for future disclosure or treat it as part of Virginia's unmeasured capacity reserve.
